He specializes in Manifest V3 Chrome extension development, AI browser copilots (OpenAI GPT-4o, Google Gemini Pro), high-frequency browser automation, web scraping, and SaaS monetization (Stripe, ExtensionPay). Available at $20/hr tracked on Upwork or fixed-price milestones.
